empty.previewDescription: No completed works with assignees for this period
empty.periodsHint: Click «Calculate period» and create the period in the calculation window
empty.noMatchDescription: No periods match the selected filter

breakdown.heading: Work order breakdown
breakdown.noWorks: No completed work in this period — only the salary share for the period is accrued.
breakdown.empty: Breakdown unavailable (period was calculated before this feature).
breakdown.note: Accrual is calculated from the base total per the pay scheme, so it is not split across work orders.

payModal.title: Process payment
payModal.note: If a cash register is selected — the amount is disbursed from it (cash-out per employee). A fiscal register requires an open shift.

blocks.title: Base
items: Labor lines of finished work orders (“Completed”, “Invoiced”, “Paid”, “Archived”) — by the line's main performer; parts are not in the base.
A work order falls into the period by completion date (Kyiv days, both included).

items.text: salary × share of the period + base × bonus percent; the share is period days in the month / days in the month

blocks.title: Important
items: No scheme — accrued 0, the row stays.
Work order labor is accrued in one payroll only: labor already accrued in a computed or paid period is skipped.
Accrual is rounded to the kopeck once — from the total.
